name: Proving Grounds 28: The Sundered Ward. The final battle, another way: a terrace of pale marble high over Hollowmark at twilight, many levels and three ways up (the west gallery, the processional between the pools, the east terraces), and the sanctum behind a glowing spirit ward torn open in three places: a two-wide breach, the shattered gate at the top of the grand stair, and a breach one cell wide.
